description: Frozen-run baseline for the round-31 blind-writer gate tools/mori-blind-check.sh. The snapshot is the round-30 writer wave (4 briefs) plus the round-30 allow file, copied byte-for-byte from lane git objects; the pinned tool is the round-31 gate blob. verify.sh re-pins every digest, then re-runs the pinned tool over a throwaway git repo built from the snapshot and compares stdout and exit code with the values recorded here.

source.note: The four briefs are the round-30 writer wave at 5c99f2d4 (the revision named by the round-31 receipt .ufo/waves/round-31/evidence/c2-tool-selftest-and-r30.txt); the allow file is the round-31 tool commit 458ff1c3; the tool blob is unchanged since 458ff1c3. Every pinned blob is byte-identical at lane_revision, so the snapshot is reproducible from the lane tip alone.

tool.digest_mismatch_class: failed (verify.sh exit 1): the pinned tool bytes changed, so the frozen verdict was not reproduced under the pinned tool. A missing tool file is 'snapshot_tampered' (exit 2): the baseline cannot be evaluated at all.

invocation.revision: the commit verify.sh creates in a throwaway git repo under $TMPDIR from snapshot/ (content-identical to the pinned bytes; the tool reads briefs from the git tree, not from the working tree)

provenance: The expected stdout and exit code are the round-31 C2 regression receipt (.ufo/waves/round-31/evidence/c2-tool-selftest-and-r30.txt), re-measured here over the byte-identical snapshot at lane_revision 8ab61aff.
